children: Downward momentum in Australia house prices has become the dominating market factor, and risks of an "overshoot" in the extent of falls is rising, especially if interest rates rise further, says Matthew Hassan, head of Australia macro forecasting at Westpac. Seasonal effects will turn positive in coming months but, on their own, these are unlikely to act as a market circuit breaker, he adds. Buyers will have the upper hand in most markets heading into the southern hemisphere's spring. Even allowing for seasonality, prices in the biggest market of Sydney tracked a 15-20% annualized pace of decline in the past three months, he notes. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
